Interface TabletMap

      • getMapping

        ConcurrentMap<KeyspaceTableNamePair,ConcurrentSkipListSet<Tablet>> getMapping()
        Returns mapping from tables to the sets of their tablets.

      • addTablet

        void addTablet(CqlIdentifier keyspace,
